_comment: agent-pr-flow's OWN instance config — the bundle gating itself (SAD-652).
Without this file land-pr.sh falls back to instance-#1 hardcoded defaults, which
expect endurance-logger's CI job name and tier patterns. The result is a funnel
that cannot land its own PRs: G2 looks for a check that does not exist here.
templates/workflow.config.example.json stays the ADOPTER template and is
deliberately endurance-logger-shaped; this file is this repo's instance copy.
This repo IS the landing machinery, so the security tier is close to total by
design. Anything that installs, gates, or is installed as an agent instruction
is security tier. Only prose and licensing are docs tier.
codeTierPolicy is deliberately ABSENT: there is no meaningful 'code' tier in a
repo with no application code, so a file matching neither list falls to the
default rather than silently landing on CI alone.

Both layouts are listed on purpose. In THIS repo the machinery lives at hooks/, scripts/, commands/, agents/. In an ADOPTER the same files are installed under .claude/. A bundle repo should gate both: the source it ships and the install surface it owns. land-pr.sh's own G0 self-test also probes '.claude/hooks/_selftest', which hardcodes instance-#1's layout — filed separately; covering both layouts is correct on its own merits, not a way around that probe.

BOTH-LAYOUTS APPLIES TO ALL SEVEN PAIRS, not five. Source -> installed: hooks/ -> .claude/hooks/, commands/ -> .claude/commands/, agents/ -> .claude/agents/, references/ -> .claude/references/, settings.fragment.json -> .claude/settings.json, scripts/ -> tools/dev/, githooks/ -> .githooks/. The last two were MISSING in the first draft, and tools/dev/** and .githooks/** are strict WEAKENINGS against the hardcoded fallback this config replaces -- land-pr.sh and pre-push would have tiered as code, i.e. no Barb (Watson, PR #9). ci/** was missing outright and ci/main-guard.yml exists in the tree today: the server-side push-provenance detector would have landed Barb-less.

LICENSE is NOT in docsTierPatterns on purpose. It was, and that was the single place this config weakened anything (code -> docs, i.e. reviewer-required -> CI-alone). Relicensing a bundle every adopter vendors is worth one Watson read (Barb, PR #9).

verification._comment: No device surface in this repo; the suites ARE the verification.
